notes.title: You wanted more!
notes.content:
I’m thrilled to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130170/Full_Metal_Sergeant_2/]Full Metal Sergeant II[/url] is currently in development!

Building on the positive feedback of its predecessor, this sequel promises to enhance your military management experience with improved gameplay mechanics and a brand-new turn-based combat system.

[h3]What’s New in Full Metal Sergeant II?[/h3]

I’ve carefully reviewed [b]every review, comment, and suggestions [/b]from the community in order to make the game more deep but still enjoyable. Full Metal Sergeant 2, is set to take players on a new tactical journey with an improved gameplay, a whole [b]new turn based combat system [/b]and new game mechanics.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/htypjgHt/combat.gif[/img]

Here’s a list of the new features. Stay tuned for more information and gameplay videos

[list]
[*] New turn-based combat system
[*] Revised Skill Tree
[*] Improved pixel art and new animations
[*] Nine specialized uniteds
[*] Hardcore mode (details later)
[/list]

Check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130170/Full_Metal_Sergeant_2/]Steam page[/url] for new videos, screenshots and more information about the new game features.

Full Metal Sergeant II is set to launch in late 2025. Don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam to stay updated with the game development.

See you at the bootcamp!
Carlo

notes.title: Update Platoons
notes.content:
New update rolled out!

[h2]Platoons revamp[/h2]
Bravo, Charlie and Delta platoons were not widely used and so they have been completely revised. Each now offers a unique bonus that adds a layer of strategy to the mission.
[list]
[*] Bravo: Can call a medevac at anytime to end the mission.
[*] Charlie: Add a recruit as a reserve; they join a platoon if a comrade dies or flees.
[*] Delta: A recruit can be promoted to Elite before going to mission (+Damage and always in cover).
[/list]
Those platoons were moved to the second tier of the skill tree. The [b]Head [/b]and [b]Kitchen [/b]locations have been moved down to the first tier.
[i](The purchase of previous platoons has been reset. Prestige will be refunded and the new platoons can be bought again)
[/i]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/4dSpF2TD/Fu-FRXH8-Xs-AAs-V7b.png[/img]


[h2]New events[/h2]
New events at the gate:
[list]
[*] Family Visit (season 2)
[*] Sharpshooters  (season 3)
[*] Museum curator (season 4)
[/list]
[i](The Official Guide will be updated in the next few days).[/i]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FsNpw8tS/Full-Metal-Sergent-1.png[/img]


[h2][BETA] Custom names[/h2]
It's now possible to define custom names for the recruits. In the Options menu you'll find two new buttons, one for exporting the template file and the other for importing it. The template is a simple text file with all the names listed.

[b]Refer to the Official Guide for the complete instructions.[/b]

Rules:
[list]
[*] Max names 73
[*] Max name length: 12 characters
[*] Only supported languages characters are allowed.
[/list]

[i](Please keep in mind this feature is in beta, so report any bug you'll find. ).[/i]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZqKzBq2R/Full-Metal-Sergent-12.png[/img]



[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a second leaderboard to keep track of missions accomplished.
[*]Added a text explaining that the ungraduated recruits won't be deployed to the mission.
[*]Added a text telling if no MOD has been assigned to a recruit.
[*]Journalist event: Added Prestige if you choose not to give the interview.
[*]Fixed a bug in which the game would crash in the Options menu if played offline.
[/list]

notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.content:
[h3]April 3rd[/h3]
I finally have a date! On April 3rd, 2023 [b]Full Metal Sergeant[/b] will be released for Windows and macOS! Over the next month I will refine the last few things!


[h3]Easy Mode[/h3]
Based on your feedback there is now an 'easy' mode you can select at the start of a new game. As a gamer, I understand that some players will want to have an easier time when learning to play or just when you want to have a more relaxed experience.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0Qz2nQhY/Full-Metal-Sergent-1.png[/img]


[h3]Official Guide[/h3]
Starting April 3rd, there will be an Official Guide in the Community Hub. This will contain many useful details, especially for an avid achievement collector :D

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/VNV4pGZx/Immagine-2023-02-24-134910.png[/img]


Gotta go! Refining those last few things... ;)
See you on the parade ground!
Carlo

notes.title: Lack of supplies? We can continue anyway!
notes.content:
[h2]Zero Supplies[/h2]
A lack of supplies no longer ends a mission in failure. Now the platoon can continue on, though with a heavy penalty to soldier stats. This should leave more flexibility during a mission.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/gkxkbqJH/Full-Metal-Sergent-1.png[/img]


[h2]New training - Rifle Drill[/h2]
Added new training; Rifle Drill will raise a recruit's Shooting at a PT zone. The Shooting Range does it better, but Rifle Drill area is available at the start.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/x1xZ0b1G/Full-Metal-Sergent-1.png[/img]


[h2]Ground audios[/h2]
Terrain-based sound has been introduced. For example, when the platoon moves into a lake tile there is now a big 'Splash' sound.


[h2]Other stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] Soldiers on missions earn more XP from non-combat events.
[*] Two initial cadences are now available at the beginning of the game.
[/list]

See you in the next update!
Carlo.

[h2]Wishlist the game![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1698350/Full_Metal_Sergeant

notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.content:
[h2]Demo version 0.310[/h2]

The demo launch provided great feedback! A number of things have been revised to improve the game.

[h3]Skill tree[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fyddQ8r9/skill-tree.png[/img]
The skill tree's passive skills have been moved to a common section. So even if you choose to specialize in one branch, there is a possibility to acquire passive skills such as 'Insult mode' (not available in demo).


[h3]Map sectors[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/J7HZXhzz/map-sector.png[/img]
When you leave the mission the current sector is now displayed to make things more clear.


[h3]Better info[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/X7MFk0rc/tutorial.png[/img]
After watching some videos of streamers, I noticed that some users were having a difficult to understand that you can click on the 'Barracks' for more information. There is now a smart tutorial that shows an animated arrow only if the 'Barracks' menu hasn't been opened by the 2nd week.


[h3]Discpline[/h3]
Based on your feedback, the 'Discipline' check during the mission now happens less frequently; soldiers will flee less often.


Thanks to everybody for playing my game! See you on the next news post...
Carlo.

notes.title: Compete against other camps!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! 

Second devblog here; this time it's all about the competition system.
In Full Metal Sergeant you will not only have to build great soldiers, but you will also have to show their skills during competitions against other camps. 

Every 2 weeks there will be new competitions available at the bulletin board. Actually there are three types: 
[list]
[*] Shooting
[*] Running
[*] Swimming
[/list]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fyDp6CG3/comp-start.gif[/img]
You have to choose the competition in which your recruits will perform best. You will be able to see the required attributes and the reward in Prestige Points. So, do you have recruits who are skilled at shooting? Then Sniper Cup. Or are you focused on agility and strength training? Then better go for a run.

In this devblog let's see the race...


[h3]Choose you man[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Gt2pVrby/comp1.gif[/img]
The first step is to choose the best recruit for the duty, so in this case, with the one with most strength and agility. Pay attention to the stamina: it is necessary to jump into the competitions with the recruits rested otherwise they will not have enough energy to complete the race. 


[h3]Run run run[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/zGVSXW5V/comp-run.gif[/img]
Watch the racer and see if your man can overtake the others...
The race is divided into multiple sessions, so if one recruit is too tired you can compete with another.


[h3]Straight to the finish line![/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/bwBgQgLx/comp-finish.gif[/img]
...this time It didn't go well, better get back to camp and push the trainings.

notes.title: DevBlog - Don't click on your sergeant!
notes.content:
Hello young recruits!

This is the first [b]Full Metal Sergeant[/b] devblog with the latest progress for the month.

[h3]PT Area[/h3]
The art of the PT area has been revised, enhanced with cones and tires. It will be possible to carry out workouts such as: Push-ups, Sit-ups, Jumping Jacks. Obviously with the sergeant yelling in the face ːsteamhappyː
[img]https://i.ibb.co/4YMqYyW/pt-area.gif[/img]

[h3]Multi-selection[/h3]
Implemented the multi-selection in order to send a group of recruits to a training area without to click one-by-one.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/F6vGvFc/multiselection.gif[/img]

[h3]Don't click on your sergeant![/h3]
It is possible to click and drag only the recruits, not your sergeant! Keep your hands off!
[img]https://i.ibb.co/rxNM5jq/click.gif[/img]

[h3]Guardhouse[/h3]
There won't be just trainings, the [b]Guardhouse [/b]for example can be useful to make a recruit recover Stamina and Stress.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/RvQtbqx/guardhouse2.png[/img]
